tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: Browse papers of one conference edition (e.g. conference="iclr", year=2025, or year=2027 for ICLR under-review submissions). Defaults to slim rows (id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, short topics) with up to 250 per page; pass fields=full for abstracts (max 25) or use get_paper.

tools.name: find_similar_papers
tools.description: Find papers related to a given paper, ranked by full-text similarity of its title and keywords. Defaults to slim rows; pass fields=full for abstracts. Optionally restrict to conferences or years.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Paperlist papers by keywords. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
